text: Investigate why a session-selected language server sees the baseline environment.

content.text: touchFile(file) started PID 123 with SENTINEL=baseline; hover(file, sessionA) started PID 124 with SENTINEL=selected.
touchFile(file, sessionA) and hover(file, sessionA) both used PID 125 with SENTINEL=selected.
The root cause in this OpenCode LSP reproduction is a missing session ID on touchFile: the sessionless call starts a separate baseline server.
